nodes.name: empty.svelte
nodes.summary: Root container primitive for the shadcn-svelte Empty component, rendering a centered dashed-border block that hosts empty-state content via a children slot.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 runes: $props with $bindable ref and spread restProps, merging classes through the cn() utility.

nodes.name: empty-header.svelte
nodes.summary: Header sub-component of the Empty primitive that stacks its children in a centered, max-width column above the title and description.

nodes.name: empty-media.svelte
nodes.summary: Media/icon slot of the Empty primitive, exposing a tailwind-variants style set (default and icon variants) for rendering an illustration or icon in the empty state.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level script block to export emptyMediaVariants (tailwind-variants tv) and the EmptyMediaVariant type via VariantProps.

nodes.name: empty-title.svelte
nodes.summary: Title sub-component of the Empty primitive that renders the empty-state heading with heading font and tight tracking.

nodes.name: empty-description.svelte
nodes.summary: Description sub-component of the Empty primitive that renders muted supporting text with underlined link styling for the empty state.

nodes.name: empty-content.svelte
nodes.summary: Content sub-component of the Empty primitive that wraps action elements (e.g. buttons) in a centered, max-width column below the header.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Empty component set, importing the sub-components and re-exporting them under both short (Root, Header, Media) and prefixed (Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia) aliases.
